title: Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration
description:
Anovia (formerly Innovatia Technical Services) is an industry-leading technology outsourcing support provider with expertise in the telecommunications industry. Operating for over 20 years, we specialize in workflow and knowledge processes, as well as technical support, helpdesk and multilingual support services. With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the world's most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

The Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration will be responsible for providing advanced technical support and leading enterprise server infrastructure operations in a large global client environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience in Linux, Windows Server, or IBM AIX administration, along with expertise in server migrations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, high availability, clustering, automation, and disaster recovery. The candidate will act as an L3 escalation point, lead complex incident resolution, drive root-cause analysis, and mentor junior administrators.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the L3 escalation point and technical lead for Linux, Windows or AIX server environments.
* Lead server migrations, OS upgrades and data centre or cloud transitions, including assessment, planning, execution and validation.
* Design and implement high availability and clustering solutions, such as Pacemaker, Windows Failover Clustering or PowerHA.
* Own major incidents end to end, lead root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
* Define and enforce standards for patching, hardening, monitoring and backup across the estate.
* Build automation frameworks with Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell or Python to reduce manual effort.
* Review and approve technical changes, and represent the team in change advisory meetings.
* Mentor L1/L2 administrators and review their work.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders on incidents, risks and service improvement plans.
* Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles.

**Skills required**

* 6+ years of hands-on administration of Linux (RHEL), Windows Server or IBM AIX in large production environments.
* Proven experience leading OS migrations, upgrades or virtualization and cloud transitions.
* Strong expertise in VMware vSphere and/or Azure or AWS infrastructure.
* Expertise in high availability, clustering and disaster recovery.
* Advanced scripting and automation using Ansible plus Shell, PowerShell or Python.
* Strong knowledge of storage (SAN/NAS, LVM), networking fundamentals, DNS, Active Directory or LDAP, and security hardening.
* Strong ITIL practices and experience owning major incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills for client-facing work.

**Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of total experience, with at least 6 years of relevant system administration experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or an equivalent discipline.
* Preferred certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft Certified (Windows Server or Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, AWS SysOps Administrator, and ITIL Foundation.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Willingness to support rotational shifts, on-call escalation and weekend change windows when required.
* Ability to work from the client office from day one.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.

**Good to have**

* Terraform and infrastructure-as-code pipelines.
* Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift administration.
* Middleware administration (WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss).
* IBM Power Systems: PowerVM, VIOS, NIM and LPAR management.
* Workload automation tools such as Control-M.

**Benefits at Anovia**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance policy
* Employee Wellness Program with focus on mental health
* Robust reward and recognition programs
* Company incentive programs offered.
* Attractive leave policy: Holiday Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Birthday leave, Bereavement Leave and Paid Leave for personal time off
* Ample growth and learning opportunities.
* Remote work opportunities
* Focus on work/life balance.
* Immigration Program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Anovia is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Infrastructure / Cloud Engineer
description:

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**About the Role**

CBS is seeking a **Senior Infrastructure/Cloud Engineer** to lead the design, automation, and security of our hybrid infrastructure landscape. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise across systems administration, networking, Infrastructure-as-Code, container orchestration, and Azure cloud, combined with the ability to mentor junior engineers, drive architectural decisions, and own critical infrastructure and security initiatives end-to-end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture, administration, and hardening of **Linux and Windows** server environments across the organization.
* Design and govern **network security architecture** — firewalls, forward/reverse proxies, DMZ zones — ensuring alignment with enterprise security standards.
* Lead the development of **Infrastructure-as-Code** standards and reusable **Terraform** modules for scalable, repeatable provisioning.
* Architect and build advanced **Python-based automation** frameworks to reduce manual operations and improve reliability.
* Drive deployment strategy and lifecycle management for applications across environments, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Lead design, scaling, and troubleshooting of **Kubernetes** clusters in production environments, including capacity planning and incident response.
* Own administration and governance of **container registries (Harbor)** — including image lifecycle policies, RBAC, and integration with vulnerability scanning pipelines.
* Architect and manage **Microsoft Azure** infrastructure (networking, compute, storage, identity) with a focus on scalability, cost optimization, and security.
* Lead **vulnerability remediation** initiatives across the estate — including **OS kernel patching** and **Java JDK** version/patch management — establishing proactive patch management processes.
* Drive root-cause analysis for critical infrastructure incidents and lead post-incident reviews.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers.
* Partner with security, application, and DevOps teams to define infrastructure standards, compliance posture, and best practices.
* Evaluate new tools/technologies and make recommendations to improve infrastructure maturity.
* Create and maintain high-quality documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Operating Systems**

* Deep expertise in both **Linux** (RHEL/Ubuntu/CentOS) and **Windows Server** administration, including performance tuning and hardening.

**Networking & Security**

* Strong command of networking fundamentals, **firewalls**, **forward and reverse proxies**, and **DMZ** architecture design.
* Proven experience securing enterprise network environments and troubleshooting complex network issues.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Advanced, hands-on experience writing and architecting **Terraform** modules for multi-environment provisioning.
* Strong proficiency in **Python** for building automation frameworks and tooling, not just scripts.

**Containers & Orchestration**

* Deep, production-grade experience with **Kubernetes** — cluster architecture, scaling, troubleshooting, and operations at scale.
* Proven experience administering **container registries**, particularly **Harbor**, including governance and security integration.

**Cloud**

* Strong, hands-on **Microsoft Azure** expertise across compute, networking, storage, and identity, with experience designing cloud architecture.

**Security & Patching**

* Proven track record remediating **OS kernel vulnerabilities** at scale.
* Strong experience managing **Java JDK patch/version** lifecycles across environments.
* Experience building or improving vulnerability management/patch management processes.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and lead technical initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder communication and ability to influence technical direction.
* Excellent documentation and process-ownership skills.
* Ability to work independently and drive projects from design through execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: **Azure Solutions Architect Expert**, **CKA/CKAD**, **Terraform Associate**, or equivalent.
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or large-scale environments with strict compliance/security requirements.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and GitOps practices.
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).
* Prior experience leading infrastructure migrations or cloud modernization projects.

**Experience Required**

* **8–12 years** of relevant experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud engineering, with at least **3+ years in a senior/lead capacity**.

.

Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field required, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, IT infrastructure, or a related field required. Demonstrates advanced capability in a primary technical area (e.g., Windows Server, Linux, VMware) with growing breadth across related domains (e.g., Cloud compute, network infrastructure). Strong structured analysis skills to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex enterprise system outages. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), VMware Certified Professional (VCP)) preferred.
